pack.name: browser-dev
pack.description: How the browser works, seen through its own developer tools.

cards.summary: A field needs a visible label

prompt.text: What gives a form field its accessible name?

hints: It should stay visible after the field is filled.

prompt.text: An image that carries meaning needs a useful
text.

answer.text: An image that carries meaning needs a useful alt text.

hints: It sits on the image tag itself.
cards.fullLine: An image that carries meaning needs a useful alt text.

teaching.text: Describe what the picture adds to the page, not every pixel.

prompt.text: Which contrast ratio meets the WCAG AA level for normal text?

hints: The smallest passing value is a little under five to one.

teaching.text: Small text needs a stronger difference than large text.

prompt.text: Keyboard users reach controls by pressing

answer.text: Keyboard users reach controls by pressing Tab.

hints: It is the key above Caps Lock.
cards.fullLine: Keyboard users reach controls by pressing Tab.

prompt.text: Which attribute adds a name when no visible label exists?

prompt.text: When should you reach for ARIA?

answer.text: only when native HTML cannot express it

options: only when native HTML cannot express it
correct: only when native HTML cannot express it

hints: A real button already does the job.
cards.fullLine: Reach for ARIA only when native HTML cannot express it.

prompt.text: A focus outline must be visible

answer.text: A focus outline must be visible clearly.

hints: Removing it strands keyboard users.
cards.fullLine: A focus outline must be visible clearly.

prompt.text: Which heading order is correct?

hints: Do not skip a level just for size.
cards.fullLine: The correct heading order is h1 then h2.

prompt.text: Screen readers navigate by the accessibility
built from the DOM.

answer.text: Screen readers navigate by the accessibility tree built from the DOM.

cards.summary: A clickable div is not a button

prompt.text: A container with a click handler has no keyboard access of its own. What is missing?

options: a role and a keyboard handler
correct: a role and a keyboard handler

hints: A real button would bring both for free.
cards.fullLine: A clickable container is missing a role and a keyboard handler.

teaching.text: A bare container has no keyboard behaviour of its own.

prompt.text: Which store keeps key-value strings until they are deleted?

prompt.text: sessionStorage is cleared when the
closes.

answer.text: sessionStorage is cleared when the tab closes.

panel.

correct: the commit that introduced the bug

prompt.text: A bug without a
is hard to prove fixed.

options: so the fix can be checked the same way
to make the bug go away
correct: so the fix can be checked the same way

hints: Your memory of the path fades.

cards.summary: Two browsers point at shared code

correct: shared code or the server response
